column18: It felt that the left branch was lighter than the right branch, and just supposed to move more. Still, I am not used to seeing the whole stem move this much in reality from what I can remember.
column20: Maybe for a young tree this is quite natural, but for me the whole tree moves too much compared to the branches.
column22: For me this feels very unnatural. It moves back and forth too quickly. Wind in nature does not blow like that, at least not where I live.
column24: The stem moves too much for my taste, otherwise the branches' movement was fine.
column26: Not too bad, I can see that it resembles wind, but some of the movements fell off, like the syncronization of the branches' movement.
column28: If I am going to say one is very natural, this is the one. The branches are very large, so here I find it more natural that the stem also moves some. Also, the syncronization of the branches' movement looks natural.
column30: Fine, even though I am not very satisfied with how the branches move together.
column32: It is more natural since there is not much wind happening, so less things go wrong.
column34: Not too bad, but there the whole movement feels a bit off, like it is a small rubber toy tree instead of a real tree.
column36: Very natural, since the wind is so weak. I do not really see anything going wrong in this video.
column38: Weak wind also in this one, but the branches felt a bit too independent of each other for a very natural look.
column40: A bit too slow in a bad way this time. The tree feels to rigid, like it has its own force together with the wind.
column42: Like a toy tree again. I do not like the wiggly movements and that the whole stem also moves back and forth.
column44: A nice and slow wind, just that the stem moves a bit much.
column46: I like this tree more, since here I am fine with the stem also moving a bit more because of the huge branches. I also like the wind going up and down a bit.
column48: Small and calm movements, with branches moving nicely toghether.
column50: Totally fine, even though maybe the small branches should move more and the leaves, since the small branches look more weak here.
column52: Some solid wind movements, with one possibly branch being more affected by wind than another, like it could be.
column54: Alright, but a bit too wiggly in places where it should not be, as the stem.
column56: Also fine, but at the end maybe it went up and down in a weird way a little.
column58: Quite natural, but sometimes the tree bends a bit more than the smaller branches justify.
column60: Here I would say the slow movement is a drawback, since it feels like the tree moves itself rather than the wind does it.
column62: I like this one too. Nice, soft and responsive movements, with the small stem being quite still.
column64: Very natural here too. Soft wind, stem in place, nothing going wrong what I can see.
